description: This file implements the RialtoConnector class, managing application sessions and state changes within the Rialto framework, including initialization, session creation, suspension, resumption, deactivation, and state change notifications.

classes.name: RialtoConnector
classes.description: A class managing Rialto application sessions and state transitions, including initialization, session control, and state change notifications.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RialtoConnector, setting up configuration and server manager service.

methods.name: createAppSession
methods.description: Creates a new application session with specified callsign, display name, and app ID.

methods.name: resumeSession
methods.description: Resumes a session identified by callsign if it is inactive.

methods.name: suspendSession
methods.description: Suspends a session identified by callsign if it is active.

methods.name: getCurrentAppState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the application session identified by callsign.

methods.name: deactivateSession
methods.description: Deactivates the session identified by callsign if it is active or inactive.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for a given app ID and updates internal state map.

methods.name: waitForStateChange
methods.description: Waits for a session to reach a specified state within a timeout period.
